title: A Study of risvutatug rezetecan in Participants with Metastatic Castration resistant Prostate Cancer (mCRPC)
official: A Phase 3 Randomized Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of risvutatug rezetecan, a B7-H3 Antibody Drug Conjugate (ADC) in Participants with Metastatic Castration-resistant Prostate Cancer (EMBOLD Prostate-302).
summary: Main objective: To compare the efficacy of Ris-Rez with BSC (with or without ARPI) in participants with relapsed mCRPC previously treated with ARPI and Taxane based therapy.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Participants ≥18 years of age or the legal age of consent in the jurisdiction in which the study is taking place at the time of signing the ICF.
2. 2. Has histologically or cytologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate.
3. 3. Has an ECOG PS of 0 or 1, with no deterioration in the 2 weeks before randomization.
4. 4. Has a life expectancy of at least 4 months.
5. 5. Has adequate organ function
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. Pathological finding consistent with small cell, neuroendocrine carcinoma of the prostate, mixed histologies or any histology different from adenocarcinoma.
2. 2. Participants with known dMMR/MSI-H/TMB-H status and eligible for immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
3. 3. Has a malignancy that has progressed or required active treatment within the past 24 months
4. 4. Has undergone major surgery, including local prostate intervention (except prostate biopsy), within 28 days before the date of randomization.
5. 5. Has clinically significant bleeding symptoms or significant bleeding tendency within 1 month prior to the first dose.
6. 6. Known active infectious diseases requiring systemic treatment or known HIV.
7. 7. Has untreated brain or CNS metastases or brain/CNS metastases that have progressed
8. 8. Has received systemic immunosuppressive agents within 30 days prior to first dose of study intervention
9. 9. Has received any prior therapy with an ADC with a TOPO1-inhibitor payload or a B7 H3 targeting antibody/ bispecific.
